bridges.scope: True-preimage transport from total Boolean decision functions to binary languages preserves and reflects class equality and inequality.

bridges.missing_target: A pinned Programme-side Lean definition of the locked deterministic multitape machine, step cost, total decider, and polynomial simulation interface.
A pinned Programme-side Lean predicate for the locked eventual worst-case polynomial bound, including constants, exponent, threshold, and all finite exceptional input lengths.
Programme-side formal verifier, self-delimiting pair encoding, witness bound, and the prerequisite machine and polynomial-bound bridges.
A selected concrete endpoint with formal parser, malformed-to-NO behavior, size measure, correctness theorem, and locked polynomial many-one reductions.

claim_boundary: This package proves only the Boolean-decision-function to binary-language carrier transport. It does not prove P equals NP, P differs from NP, either imported-to-Programme class equivalence, a Turing-machine simulation, a polynomial-bound conversion, an endpoint theorem, novelty, or any MATHCERT disposition.
